subject: SAML / SCIM / IP sprint coordination - SummitBank onboarding
messages:
From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@summitbank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@summitbank.com>, it-admin@summitbank.com
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: SummitBank onboarding - SAML/SCIM/IP sprint kickoff

Vanessa / Redwood team,

Thanks for the quick turn here. Per our internal timeline wed like to run a focused sprint next week to get SAML (IdP metadata exchange), SCIM mappings, and the IP allowlist verified so we can cut over by 11/20.

High-level asks from our side: 
- Exchange SAML metadata and confirm attribute mapping (email, name, groups).
- Review the SCIM schema mapping spreadsheet attached and confirm required vs optional attributes.
- Confirm static IP ranges we should allow from Redwood for production egress (were attaching our allowlist file).
- Service account provisioning: wed like a non-interactive service account for user-syncs and platform health checks; please advise required scopes.

Could you confirm availability for a 45m working session Monday 11/9 or Tuesday 11/10 (PST)? If Monday works, wed cover metadata exchange + SCIM mapping decisions; if Tuesday wed focus on IP allowlist and service accounts.

I attached the SCIM_Mapping_v1.xlsx and IP_Allowlist_Ranges.txt. If you prefer a Doc instead of the spreadsheet I can move it to GDrive.

Thanks,
Jordan Ellis
Senior PM, Identity & Access
SummitBank

--
Attachment stubs: SCIM_Mapping_v1.xlsx (sheet: attributes), IP_Allowlist_Ranges.txt
From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@summitbank.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SummitBank onboarding - SAML/SCIM/IP sprint kickoff

Jordan —

Appreciate the clear scope. Monday 11/9 10:00–10:45am PST works for us for the initial working session. Agenda proposal: 
1) Quick introductions & success criteria (5m)
2) SAML metadata exchange and attribute mapping decisions (20m)
3) SCIM required attributes and provisioning flow (15m)
4) Action items & owners (5m)

Well bring:
- A Redwood SAML metadata XML (Ill attach prior to the meeting)
- Our recommended SCIM mappings and min-set of attributes for user provisioning
- A proposed service-account roles/scopes doc for your security team to review

Priyom will lead the technical mapping and Laura will cover rollout/cutover runbook (canary + rollback).

Deliverables we expect after the session: finalized SAML metadata exchange, SCIM mapping sign-off (spreadsheet with required/optional flags), list of IPs to add to your allowlist plus any ephemeral ranges we need to account for during bursts.

If thats aligned Ill send a calendar invite with a dedicated Google Drive folder and attach the Redwood_SAML_Metadata.xml and our SCIM_recommendations doc.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0172

--
Attachment stub: Redwood_SAML_Metadata.xml
From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@summitbank.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SummitBank onboarding - SAML/SCIM/IP sprint kickoff

Vanessa / team —

Thanks, confirmed for Monday 11/9 10:00am PST. A couple of notes from our security team ahead of the call: 
- For SAML we require email (userPrincipalName), givenName, surname and one group attribute mapped to our RBAC system. Please indicate if Redwood can surface groups in the assertion or whether we should rely on SCIM.
- SCIM: the attached spreadsheet is our canonical mapping. We flagged primaryEmail as immutable; we need user.active to be writable from Redwood for deprovision flows.
- IP allowlist: the file is our production perimeter ranges. We can add static entries during cutover but will need a short maintenance window if any prod ranges change.

Finally, security will want the service account to authenticate with mTLS and limited scopes: scim:write, health:read. Can Redwood support mTLS for service accounts?

Jordan

--

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Rao <priya.rao@summitbank.com>, Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@summitbank.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SummitBank onboarding - SAML/SCIM/IP sprint kickoff

Hi Priya / Jordan —

Great working session today — thanks to everyone for being pragmatic. Summary and open items: 

Summary: 
- SAML: exchanged metadata; Redwood will send final SP metadata with assertion examples by EOD 11/8. We confirmed attributes: email (NameID/emailAddress), givenName, familyName; groups will be sent in an optional Groups attribute (security ok with relying on SCIM for group sync for now).
- SCIM: agreed required attributes: userName (immutable), active (writable), name.givenName, name.familyName, emails[type=work].primary. Redwood will post provisioning events to /scim/v2/Users and will support PATCH for deprovision.
- Service account: Redwood supports client-certificate (mTLS) for the service credential and will issue a cert per customer instance. Scoped permissions: scim:write, health:read — approved.
- IP allowlist: Redwood provided a stable set of egress IPs (in folder) and agreed to notify SummitBank 72h before any changes to prod ranges.

Open action items (owners & due dates): 
1) Redwood: send SP metadata + assertion example (vanessa) — due 2026-11-08 EOD.
2) Redwood: PR to SCIM mapping spreadsheet with required/optional flags and sample PATCH payload (priyom) — due 2026-11-09 noon PST.
3) SummitBank: confirm change window availability for 11/19 cutover and add Redwood prod IPs to allowlist (Jordan/Priya) — due 2026-11-12.
4) Security: sign-off on mTLS cert provisioning process (SummitBank security) — due 2026-11-12.

Attachments uploaded to folder: Redwood_SAML_Metadata.xml, SCIM_Mapping_v1.xlsx (annotated), IP_Allowlist_Ranges.txt

If that aligns Ill open a tracking ticket in the customer repo and create a short runbook for the 11/19 maintenance window (canary steps + rollback).

Thanks again — looking forward to the cutover.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0172
